integrity: The claims are supported by a self-contained mathematical derivation and a finite independent-code cross-check. No claim of independent proof validation or of complete prior-art exclusion is made.
scientific_limitations: Separate 00 and 11 frequencies, higher-order patterns and sharp constants are not established. The base 3/2 special case is known; novelty concerns the all-coprime-parameter exact equation and derived density. Literature review is bounded and not an external audit.
title: A universal adjacent-change law for rational-base digit-sum parity
